name: Green Slime
description: Green Slime is a basic enemy in Act 1-3 of the forest biome. It is the weakest enemy in game.

name: Blue Slime
description: Blue Slime is a basic enemy in Act 1-3 of the forest biome. It can also be spawned by King Slime.

name: Purple Slime
description: Purple Slime is an enemy in Act 1-3 of the forest biome. It is a bulky variation of Green Slime and Blue Slime.

name: Pinky
description: Pinky is an enemy in Act 1-3 of the forest biome. It have high amount of health and fast, but have negative defense.

name: Umbrella Slime
description: Umbrella Slime is an enemy in Act 1-3 of the forest biome, exclusively spawned during Rain.

name: Flying Fish
description: Flying Fish is an enemy exclusively spawned during Rain.

name: Golden Slime
description: Golden Slime is an enemy in Act 1-3 of the forest biome. It is a more bulky variation of Purple Slime and luxurious.

name: Spiked Slime
description: Spiked Slime is an enemy in Act 1-3 of the forest biome. It can also be spawned by King Slime.

name: King Slime
description: King Slime is a boss in Act 3 of the forest biome. It is a slime boss that is slow, bulky and able to occassionally spawn large amount of Blue Slime and Spiked Slime.

name: Zombie
description: Zombie is a basic enemy in Act 4-6 of the forest biome. It is spawned at Night.

name: Maggot Zombie
description: Maggot Zombie is an enemy in Act 4-6 of the forest biome. It is spawned at Night, and it is a stronger variant of Zombie.

name: Demon Eye
description: Demon Eye is a basic enemy in Act 4-6 of the forest biome. It is spawned at Night.

name: Dilated Eye
description: Demon Eye is an enemy in Act 4-6 of the forest biome. It is a stronger variant of Demon Eye.

name: Raincoat Zombie
description: Raincoat Zombie is an enemy in Act 4-6 of the forest biome. It is spawned at Night, and it is a rain variant of Zombie.

name: Servant of Cthulhu
description: Servant of Cthulhu is an enemy in Act 4-6 of the forest biome. It can also be spawned by Eye of Cthulhu.

name: Eye of Cthulhu
description: The Eye of Cthulhu is a boss in Act 6 of the forest biome. It is a flying boss that has 2 phases. the first phase is slow, bulky, and able to spawn Servant of Cthulhu, while the second phase is fast with no defence, but has the ability to dash, making it able to accelerate towards the base, dashing happens more often the lower their health.

name: Blood Zombie
description: Blood Zombie is a unique enemy in Act 7 of the forest biome. It is exclusively spawned during Blood Moon event.

name: Drippler
description: Drippler is a unqiue enemy in Act 7 of the forest biome. It is exclusively spawned during Blood Moon event.

name: The Groom
description: The Groom is a unique enemy in Act 7 of the forest biome. It is exclusively spawned during Blood Moon event.

name: The Bride
description: The Bride is a unique enemy in Act 7 of the forest biome. It is exclusively spawned during Blood Moon event.

name: Zombie Merman
description: Zombie Merman is a unqiue enemy in Act 7 of the forest biome. It is exclusively spawned during Blood Moon event via fishing. They gets stronger each time being fished up.

name: Wandering Eye Fish
description: Wandering Eye Fish is a unique enemy in Act 7 of the forest biome. It is exclusively spawned during Blood Moon event via fishing. They gets stronger each time being fished up.

name: Famished Maggot
description: Farmished Maggot is a unique enemy in Act 7 of the forest biome. It is exclusively spawned during Blood Moon event, and can also be repeatedly spawned by Patchwerk.

name: Bursting Maggot
description: Farmished Maggot is a unique enemy in Act 7 of the forest biome. It is exclusively spawned during Blood Moon event, and can also be repeatedly spawned by Patchwerk.

name: Patchwerk
description: The Patchwerk is a boss in Act 7 of the forest biome during Blood Moon event. It is a boss with an ability to occasionally spawn many of Famished Maggot and Bursting Maggot, and becoming more frequent the lower its health is.

name: Sand Slime
description: Green Slime is a basic enemy in desert biome.

name: Antlion
description: Antlion is an enemy in desert biome that spawned on random location around the map. It can shoot sand to stun a unit.

name: Albino Antlion
description: Antlion is a rare enemy in desert biome that spawned on random location around the map. It is a rare variant of Antlion. It can also shoot sand to stun a unit.

name: Antlion Larva
description: Antlion Larva is a basic enemy in desert biome.

name: Vulture
description: Vulture is a basic enemy in desert biome.

name: Tomb Crawler
description: Tomb Crawler is an enemy in desert biome. It is a bulky enemy with its defense.

name: Angry Tumbler
description: Angry Tumbler is an enemy exclusively spawned during Windy in desert biome. It also always spawned in Act 3 of Desert.

name: Storm Hatchling
description: Storm Hatchling is an enemy in desert biome, exclusively spawned during Storm in Desert Act 3. It can also be spawned by The Grand Thunder Bird.

name: The Grand Thunder Bird
description: The Grand Thunder Bird is a boss of Act 3 of Desert biome. It is a flying boss that can dash _really far_ distances, can spawning Storm Hatchling(s) and summon lightning bolts to stun nearby units and speed up nearby enemies. However rather than just moving toward the base like any normal enemy would do, instead it circled around the path of Desert map before entering the base.

name: Antlion Charger
description: Antlion Charger is an enemy in desert biome. it is one of the Antlion variant in the desert.

name: Giant Antlion Charger
description: Giant Antlion Charger is an enemy in desert biome. it is a stronger variant of Antlion Charger.

name: Antlion Swarmer
description: Antlion Swarmer is an enemy in desert biome. it is one of the Antlion variant in the desert.

name: Giant Antlion Swarmer
description: Antlion Swarmer is an enemy in desert biome. it is a stronger variant of Antlion Swarmer.

name: Desert Nuisance
description: Desert Nuisance is a very strong enemy in desert biome. It is a strong variant of Tomb Crawler. It can also be spawned by Desert Scourge.

name: Desert Scourge
description: Desert Scourge is a boss of Act 5 of Desert biome. It is a grounded boss that can dig into the ground and gain more defenses, then launch itself into the sky, increases its walkspeed temporarily. When reaching half of its health, it will summon a Desert Nuisance and spawn another one if there was none in the map. It also gets gradually faster and gains more defense the lower its health. It can also stunned nearby units, inflincting 8 seconds of Confusion. However rather than just moving toward the base like any normal enemy would do, instead it circled around the path of Desert map before entering the base.

name: Ice Slime
description: Ice Slime is a snow version of slime in snow biome.

name: Slush Slime
description: Slush Slime is a tankier variant of Ice Slime in snow biome.

name: Spiked Ice Slime
description: Spiked Ice Slime is a spiked version of Ice Slime in snow biome.

name: Snow Flinx
description: Snow Flinx is an enemy in snow biome.

name: Frozen Zombie
description: Frozen Zombie is one of a variant of zombie enemy in snow biome.

name: Cyan Beetle
description: Cyan Beetle is one of a variant of beetle enemy in snow biome.

name: Ice Bat
description: Ice Bat is an ice variant of Bat enemy in snow biome.

name: Undead Viking
description: Undead Viking is a tanky enemy resemble a viking in snow biome.

name: Deerclops
description: Deerclops is a boss of Act 4 of Snow biome. It is a boss that have an ability to send a frozen shockwave toward the nearby units. The shockwave can hit up to 5 units inside its range, stunned the targeted unit by inflicting 8 seconds of Confusion.

name: Raven
description: Raven is an event enemy during the Halloween, they have a chance to be spawned at night.

name: Bunny Slime
description: Bunny Slime is an event variant of a slime enemy during the Halloween. They're a costumed slime that have a chance to replace a normal one during the event.

name: Costumed  Zombies
description: Costumed Zombies are an event variant of a zombie enemy during the Halloween. They're a costumed zombie that have a chance to replace a normal one during the event. There are 3 variants of them being Pixie, Superman and Nurse.

name: Costumed Demon Eyes
description: Costumed Demon Eyes are an event variant of a zombie enemy during the Halloween. They're a costumed demon eye that have a chance to replace a normal one during the event. There are 2 variants of them being Spaceship, and Owl.
